# It’s Worth Brivo

#### Manage your business’s security in one powerful platform.

From access control to video surveillance, visitor management to business optimization, harness the
power of AI to take total control of your security system.

###### Platform

## Brivo Security Suite: Unified Physical Security for the Modern Enterprise

Centralize access control, video surveillance, visitor management, alarms, and sensors into a
single, cloud-native platform where the solutions work together. Our Open API integrates with your
existing IT and operational systems to automate security and align with your business needs.
[
Access Control
][237]

Easily control who can access your buildings and when, while tracking all activity within a secure
cloud-based platform.

[
Video Surveillance
][238]

Gain real-time insights and proactive alerts by integrating access control with video surveillance
for a comprehensive security view.

[
Visitor Management
][239]

Monitor all guest and vendor traffic at every entry point to ensure total visibility over who is on
site.

[
Intrusion and Monitoring
][240]

Detect unauthorized activity, investigate with synced video, and leverage 24/7 monitoring to reduce
false alarms.

businesses need for total property protection, all in one unified platform.

Transform video into proactive intelligence with AI-driven insights for risk prevention, faster
incident response, and greater operational clarity.

###### Industries

## Unified Security Solutions Built for Your Industry

Every industry faces unique security challenges. Brivo delivers tailored solutions that protect your
people, streamline operations, and scale with your business — no matter what you’re protecting.

Centralize global security management and automate compliance across thousands of locations with one
scalable, cloud-based dashboard.

##### Commercial Business

Modernize office security with a platform that enables remote management, mobile credentials, and
more efficient building operations.

##### Multifamily

Centralize portfolio management and reduce turnover costs with a unified platform that supports
mobile entry, self-guided tours, and whole-community protection.

  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.

  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

Adaptive Recognition is the pioneering force in image processing technology, shaping the future of
smarter mobility and safer identity verification. Our suite of ANPR/LPR hardware and software and ID
& verification solutions optimise traffic flow, enhance access control, and secures identification. 

تُعد Adaptive Recognition قوة رائدة في تقنيات معالجة الصور، حيث تُسهم في تشكيل مستقبل التنقل الذكي
والتحقق الآمن من الهوية. تعمل حلولنا من الأجهزة والبرمجيات الخاصة بالتعرف على لوحات المركبات (التعرف
التلقائي على لوحات الأرقام / التعرف على لوحات الأرقام) وحلول قراءة الهوية والتحقق منها على تحسين حركة
المرور، وتعزيز التحكم في الوصول، وتأمين التعرف على الهويات.

Adaptive Recognition to pionier w technologii przetwarzania obrazu, kształtujący przyszłość
inteligentnej mobilności i bezpiecznej weryfikacji tożsamości. Nasze rozwiązania sprzętowe i
programowe do automatycznego rozpoznawania tablic rejestracyjnych (ANPR/LPR – automatyczne
rozpoznawanie tablic / odczyt tablic) oraz systemy odczytu i weryfikacji tożsamości usprawniają
przepływ ruchu, zwiększają kontrolę dostępu i zapewniają bezpieczną identyfikację.

Adaptive Recognition je priekopníckou silou v oblasti technológií spracovania obrazu, formujúcou
budúcnosť inteligentnej mobility a bezpečnej overovania identity. Naša ponuka hardvéru a softvéru
ANPR/LPR a riešení na overovanie ID optimalizuje tok dopravy, zlepšuje kontrolu prístupu a
zabezpečuje identifikáciu.

Az Adaptive Recognition úttörő szerepet tölt be a jármű- és okmányazonosítási technológiák
területén, támogatva a közlekedési folyamatok hatékony működését és a megbízható
személyazonosság-ellenőrzést. Rendszámfelismerő hardver- és szoftvermegoldásaink, valamint
okmányolvasási és ellenőrzési technológiáink optimalizálják a forgalmat, egyszerűsítik a
beléptetést, és gyors, pontos személyazonosítást tesznek lehetővé.

# Allmar Inc. is pleased to announce the acquisition of Apex Door Opening Solutions, effective June
# 1st, 2026.

Allmar Inc. is pleased to announce the acquisition of Apex Door Opening Solutions, effective June
1st, 2026.

Allmar strives to provide maximum value to its customers along with industry leading project
fulfillment and customer service, proudly representing the world’s leading manufacturers and
offering the very best in architectural door, hardware, security, garage door and miscellaneous
specialties products. Since 1957, Allmar has provided quality construction products and services for
the architectural openings industry, serving commercial, industrial, institutional and residential
markets, with locations in 14 Canadian cities from B.C. through Ontario. Canadian owned and
operated, Allmar is proud of our strong culture, family values and family-owned business heritage,
as well as our recent investment by SeaFort Capital of Halifax.

Ron Jonkman, CEO of Allmar commented, “the acquisition of Apex Door Opening Solutions furthers
Allmar’s expansion objectives across Canada and we are thrilled to invest in Atlantic Canada. We are
proud of the history and values of Apex Door Opening Solutions and to welcome new employees to the
Allmar family.”

Brad Miles, CSO of Allmar added, “Allmar is excited to grow our customer base, deepen our market
share growth and leverage market opportunities in Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and the rest of
Atlantic Canada.”

Should you have any questions please contact Elise Mayberry, Vice President of Marketing.

Sincerely,
Allmar Inc.

# Special Announcement- SeaFort Capital

**Investment of SeaFort Capital of Halifax Announcement**
Date: March 2, 2026

Effective March 2nd, Allmar Inc. is excited to announce the investment of SeaFort Capital of
Halifax, a leading Canadian direct private investment firm that specializes in investing and growing
mid-market Canadian companies with strong leadership, together with Roynat Equity Partners.

As Canada’s premier team of architectural door, hardware, security, and miscellaneous building
specialties experts, the partnership will accelerate the company’s expansion objectives across
Canada and support ongoing operational improvements as well as continued advancement of our valued
employee, customer and partner relationships.

# Allmar Inc. is pleased to announce the acquisition of Apex Door Opening Solutions, effective June
# 1st, 2026.

Allmar Inc. is pleased to announce the acquisition of Apex Door Opening Solutions, effective June
1st, 2026.

Allmar strives to provide maximum value to its customers along with industry leading project
fulfillment and customer service, proudly representing the world’s leading manufacturers and
offering the very best in architectural door, hardware, security, garage door and miscellaneous
specialties products. Since 1957, Allmar has provided quality construction products and services for
the architectural openings industry, serving commercial, industrial, institutional and residential
markets, with locations in 14 Canadian cities from B.C. through Ontario. Canadian owned and
operated, Allmar is proud of our strong culture, family values and family-owned business heritage,
as well as our recent investment by SeaFort Capital of Halifax.

Ron Jonkman, CEO of Allmar commented, “the acquisition of Apex Door Opening Solutions furthers
Allmar’s expansion objectives across Canada and we are thrilled to invest in Atlantic Canada. We are
proud of the history and values of Apex Door Opening Solutions and to welcome new employees to the
Allmar family.”

Brad Miles, CSO of Allmar added, “Allmar is excited to grow our customer base, deepen our market
share growth and leverage market opportunities in Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and the rest of
Atlantic Canada.”

Should you have any questions please contact Elise Mayberry, Vice President of Marketing.

Sincerely,
Allmar Inc.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &
Cybersecurity yang andal.

control solutions for commercial, residential and NDIS projects across Australia.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

and process integration.

##### MSAT (Manufacturing Sciences & Technology)

We are able to provide fast, efficient and robust vaccine technology transfer with single-use

process validation.

##### Plasmid DNA Manufacturing Services

Leukocytes, platelets, cancer cells and even neural cells. They are classified into three groups
depending on their size.

## **Security Starts with Behavior**

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

## **Accelerating Security Operations with Agentic AI**

****AI Agent-Powered TDIR****

Automate and accelerate threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR). An integrated team of
AI agents streamlines the entire TDIR workflow, from enriching threat data to building
evidence-backed timelines. Experience faster and more precise investigations, increasing team
productivity.

[target]

****Insider Threat Coverage for Humans and Agents****

Monitor behavior of both employees and AI agents to gain visibility into this new class of insider
threat. User and entity behavior analytics (UEBA) and Agent Behavior Analytics (ABA) automatically
baseline activity, exposing anomalies that signal an actionable threat.

[outcomes]

****Quantifiable, Outcomes-Focused Security****

Benchmark and prove the value of your security program against peers and measurable outcomes.
Translate raw security data into business-relevant insights to demonstrate progress against your
most strategic use cases, MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, and compliance initiatives.

[sign post]

****Unmatched Customer Choice and Flexibility****

Maximize your investment in best-of-breed security tools with an open platform. Gain a unified view
of your security operation without getting locked into a proprietary scheme. Control costs with
advanced data pipeline management that allows you to search data in place and leverage low-cost

## Global biometrics leader, offering intelligent edge to cloud biometrics

We envision a secure, seamless world where you are the key to everything. Our solutions – trusted by
enterprises, fintechs, and OEMs – power hundreds of millions of products, enabling billions of
secure, convenient authentications daily across devices, cards, and digital platforms.
* [ Fingerprints ][38]

* [ Facial Authentication ][40]
* [ Identity Cloud ][41]

## Security At Your Fingertips

Fingerprint biometrics remain the gold standard for fast, secure, and user-friendly identity
verification. With over a two decades of innovation, and almost 2 Billion sensors shipped, our
fingerprint technology delivers industry-leading accuracy, speed, and reliability across a wide
range of use cases.


From unlocking your phone to accessing critical systems in government and enterprise environments,
our technology provides a trusted layer of biometric security designed to fit seamlessly into your
product or infrastructure. We offer both modular sensors for integration as well as end-to-end
biometric systems in a package (SiP) for turnkey deployment.

[ Find Out More ][42]

## Access With A Glance

Iris Recognition technology delivers unmatched biometric precision for scenarios where security,
hygiene, and accuracy are paramount.

Built to identify individuals using the unique patterns in the human iris, our solutions are ideal
for high-security applications, such as national ID programs, border control, and secure access to
sensitive systems.

Leveraging proprietary algorithms, near-infrared imaging, and liveness detection, our iris
technology offers contactless authentication, even when users wear glasses, masks, or face coverings
— making it a reliable solution in both public health and high-threat environments.

[ Find Out More ][43]

## Face the Future of Authentication

Facial recognition is redefining how we authenticate identity in a digital-first, privacy-conscious
world. Our cutting-edge facial recognition technology enables contactless, secure, and user-friendly
authentication - whether you're verifying access to a building, logging into a mobile app, or
managing large-scale identity programs.

Built on advanced AI and machine learning, our solution supports 2D and 3D imaging, delivers instant
face matching, and includes built-in liveness detection to ensure the person in front of the camera
is real.

[ Find Out More ][44]

Identity Nodes are a next-generation solution for biometric data protection, allowing organizations
to store, manage, and access biometric templates across distributed and decentralized storage nodes.

Unlike centralized systems, where a breach could compromise every user, Identity Nodes use template
fragmentation and distributed storage, ensuring that no single node holds the full biometric
identity. This architecture delivers unparalleled privacy compliance, resilience against attacks,
and data sovereignty - all while enabling seamless authentication workflows.

# Farpointe Data, the OEM for RFID Readers and Credentials

## *Touchless ID Solutions for Electronic Access Control*

Farpointe Data's mission is to provide extremely reliable RFID products and options that let our
electronic access control channel partners supply value-added solutions at highly competitive
prices. Since 2003, we've offered these security professionals a selection of premium OEM
contactless identification solutions—both standard and custom—based upon our own 125-kHz proximity,
13.56-MHz smartcard, 433-MHz long-range, and now 2.4-GHz mobile technologies. Our vision is to
remain the preferred supplier of RFID products and options for electronic access control to a
growing community of global specifiers, dealers, integrators, VARs and system manufacturers.

FROM INDIA

**We’ve been building biometric attendance systems in India since 1996. **We design, manufacture,
and support our biometric attendance systems and access control solutions end to end. From PCB
design to field level deployment – everything is done in-house.
* **We build our own hardware.** 30 hardware SKUs — face recognition devices, fingerprint biometric
  machines, handheld terminals, IoT access control panels, card readers, and QR readers. Every
  biometric attendance machine in our range — from face recognition terminals to finger print
  machines to handheld devices — is engineered in-house.
* **We develop our own software.** 9 software modules covering time and attendance, door access
  control, visitor management, canteen management, contract labour, guard tour monitoring, and more.
* **We support what we sell.** 500+ channel partners across India along with growing international
  presence. Company-owned offices in Kolkata, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, and Patna.

# The Free Enterprise Collaboration Platform

[ Download][13]
Latest version 2.1.11
[ Register Online][14]
Become a member of the Community
 

## What is it?

Foswiki is a platform, so you and your team members can collaborate and edit pages directly in the
web browser. For advanced collaboration, Foswiki lets you enter macros to automate pages and build
entire applications from within your browser. Find out [what makes Foswiki the ideal collaboration
tool][15] for your project, team or business.

## Benefits
* World class **[text editor built in][16]**, so that you get what you see.
* Create **[dynamic pages][17]**: status boards, to-do lists, inventory systems, employee handbooks,
  bug trackers and much more
* **Customize the layout** of the site, or per page, user or group
* Over **[200 polished extensions][18] all actively maintained,** to expand the out of the box
  functions
* **[Compatible with TWiki][19]**, including a **[seamless migration path][20]**
* **[Free, friendly, and effective community-based support][21]** by a community dedicated to
  democracy

## Showcase

[rocket boards]

[See more sites built with Foswiki][22]

## Project News
* [Foswiki 2.1.11 is released][23]
  important security fixes, upgrading is highly recommended

  better performance, new features, bug fixes n stuff

  this one includes some very important security fixes, update urgent
  06 August 2023 | security, cve

  Updating a docker instance is easy and fast.
  05 April 2022 | docker, update, installation, migration
* [Foswiki 2.1.7 is released][27]
  28 March 2022 | security

[See all news][28]

## Extension news

activated , [DBCachePlugin][30] 18.00 implements reverse indexes to speed up queries ,
[WikiWorkbenchContrib][31] 6.30 removes unused non-functional service scripts that might cause more
harm than being of any use , [WebCreatorPlugin][32] 3.30 security release removes overwrite flag
07 April 2026
[TablePlugin][33] 2.01 fixes error in caption parameter
01 April 2026
[TodoListPlugin][34] 2.02 fixes an internal server error triggered by using a non-existing topic
30 March 2026
[TodoListPlugin][35] 2.01 fixes reading todos from a different topic
24 March 2026
[WebStatisticsPlugin][36] 0.90 comes with multiple imporant fixes, i.e. adds support for
[FileStoreContrib][37] , [SysinfoPlugin][38] 1.00 initial release - detailed operating system
information [NEW] , [JQColoredTablePlugin][39] 1.00 initial release - colorize tables dynamically
[NEW] , [GeoCoderPlugin][40] 1.00 initial release - get geo location of an address [NEW]
Load More

## Where to go from here?

Foswiki lets you organize your website into separate webs. The [Extensions Web][41] lets you add new
capabilities to your site. Go to the [Support Web][42] to browse repository of support questions or
to find out about getting support.

[Learn about all webs on this site, and how to keep up to date.][43]

### Talk to us

[Chat in realtime on IRC][44], participate on our [mailing lists][45], [report a sensitive security
issue][46] or just cheer us up with [a short mail][47].

Find a [Foswiki consultant][48] to create or customize your Foswiki site.

### Meet the Community

Learn about the [Foswiki Community][49]. The [Foswiki Association][50] is a non-profit foundation,
tasked with caring for the interests of the Foswiki project. Find out who are the [people building
Foswiki][51]. [Register for an account][52], and [play in the Sandbox][53].

### Donate

Foswiki is in need of labour and money. If you want to donate the latter, please use the Donate
button.

Get information on [how to donate][54].

# The Free Enterprise Collaboration Platform

[ Download][13]
Latest version 2.1.11
[ Register Online][14]
Become a member of the Community
 

## What is it?

Foswiki is a platform, so you and your team members can collaborate and edit pages directly in the
web browser. For advanced collaboration, Foswiki lets you enter macros to automate pages and build
entire applications from within your browser. Find out [what makes Foswiki the ideal collaboration
tool][15] for your project, team or business.

## Benefits
* World class **[text editor built in][16]**, so that you get what you see.
* Create **[dynamic pages][17]**: status boards, to-do lists, inventory systems, employee handbooks,
  bug trackers and much more
* **Customize the layout** of the site, or per page, user or group
* Over **[200 polished extensions][18] all actively maintained,** to expand the out of the box
  functions
* **[Compatible with TWiki][19]**, including a **[seamless migration path][20]**
* **[Free, friendly, and effective community-based support][21]** by a community dedicated to
  democracy

## Showcase

[rocket boards]

[See more sites built with Foswiki][22]

## Project News
* [Foswiki 2.1.11 is released][23]
  important security fixes, upgrading is highly recommended
  15 March 2026 | cve, security
* [Foswiki 2.1.9 is released][24]
  better performance, new features, bug fixes n stuff
  18 December 2024 | performance, features
* [Foswiki 2.1.8 is released][25]
  this one includes some very important security fixes, update urgent
  06 August 2023 | security, cve
* [Updating Docker-Foswiki to 2.1.7][26]
  Updating a docker instance is easy and fast.
  05 April 2022 | docker, update, installation, migration
* [Foswiki 2.1.7 is released][27]
  28 March 2022 | security

[See all news][28]

## Videos

## Extension news

27 May 2026
[DBCacheContrib][29] 7.30 removes configuration settings that entail a broken/incorrect cache when
activated , [DBCachePlugin][30] 18.00 implements reverse indexes to speed up queries ,
[WikiWorkbenchContrib][31] 6.30 removes unused non-functional service scripts that might cause more
harm than being of any use , [WebCreatorPlugin][32] 3.30 security release removes overwrite flag
07 April 2026
[TablePlugin][33] 2.01 fixes error in caption parameter
01 April 2026
[TodoListPlugin][34] 2.02 fixes an internal server error triggered by using a non-existing topic
30 March 2026
[TodoListPlugin][35] 2.01 fixes reading todos from a different topic
24 March 2026
[WebStatisticsPlugin][36] 0.90 comes with multiple imporant fixes, i.e. adds support for
[FileStoreContrib][37] , [SysinfoPlugin][38] 1.00 initial release - detailed operating system
information [NEW] , [JQColoredTablePlugin][39] 1.00 initial release - colorize tables dynamically
[NEW] , [GeoCoderPlugin][40] 1.00 initial release - get geo location of an address [NEW]
Load More

## Where to go from here?

Foswiki lets you organize your website into separate webs. The [Extensions Web][41] lets you add new
capabilities to your site. Go to the [Support Web][42] to browse repository of support questions or
to find out about getting support.

[Learn about all webs on this site, and how to keep up to date.][43]

### Talk to us

[Chat in realtime on IRC][44], participate on our [mailing lists][45], [report a sensitive security
issue][46] or just cheer us up with [a short mail][47].

Find a [Foswiki consultant][48] to create or customize your Foswiki site.

### Meet the Community

Learn about the [Foswiki Community][49]. The [Foswiki Association][50] is a non-profit foundation,
tasked with caring for the interests of the Foswiki project. Find out who are the [people building
Foswiki][51]. [Register for an account][52], and [play in the Sandbox][53].

### Donate

Foswiki is in need of labour and money. If you want to donate the latter, please use the Donate
button.

Get information on [how to donate][54].

## Find us on the Web

GDH is a global IT staffing and professional services firm committed to always delivering more.
Better talent. More client support. World-class workforce outcomes. Let’s get to work.

GDH helps organizations solve today’s most critical technology challenges through specialized talent

* Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation
* Data Engineering & Analytics
* Cybersecurity & Risk Management
* Cloud Transformation

* DevOps & Platform Engineering

* Digital Transformation

Fortune 500 recruiting solutions partner.

## WE CARE ABOUT PEOPLE

Right from the start with GDH you will notice a difference. We’re a company driven by care. Genuine
care for our clients’ businesses and goals. Enthusiastic care for the career and life journeys of
our consultants and employees. Care to us is so much more than a nice idea. It’s fundamental to who

## Business Security Systems Installed By Pros

A business Security System is only as good as the Security System Installers that implement it.  At
Safe and Sound Security, we pride ourselves on going above and beyond for the customer on every
project we take on.  Whether you’re looking for a surveillance camera installation or an access
control system installation, it’s important that the security system installer you choose has the
experience and vision to help you achieve your security goals.  Our commercial security services are
about more than surveillance system installation or alarm system installation.  It’s our commitment
to customer success before and after the project that sets us apart from our competitors.  When we
tackle a project that integrates a security system, we take a wholistic approach to installing
business security cameras, Access Control Systems, commercial alarm systems, or CCTV cameras.  From
the engineering process to the final customer training, we treat our customers like our partner.

// NETWORK AND SECURITY EXPERT · INDEPENDENT CONSULTANT AND ADVISOR · Ontario, Canada

# Networks, physical security, and cybersecurity.
# Independent advice on all three.

Hans Study is an independent network and security consultant and advisor based in Ontario, Canada.
Boutique work in controls, security systems, and the infrastructure underneath them. Hardening and
tuning specialist for Microsoft Windows, Cisco, Aruba, and Genetec. Clients engage Hans when the
problem is complicated and they need someone who will tell them what is true, not what is profitable
to say.

[Start a conversation][63] [What this covers ↓][64]
15+ Years in enterprise infrastructure and security
6 Core sectors served across Canada and the US
100s+ Practitioners taught and mentored

// ENGINEERING

## Hands-on technical work, done independently.

The delivery side of the practice. Design, review, troubleshoot, harden, and stabilize the systems
and networks an operation runs on. Independent of reseller and integrator incentives. Not a
reseller, not an integrator. I work with integrators and end clients to make the system work for
them.

[

### Genetec Security Center

Independent Genetec consulting. Architecture review, sizing, federation, deployment oversight, and
troubleshooting. Not a reseller, not an integrator. No license revenue.

Learn more → ][65][

### CCTV and Access Control

Vendor-agnostic design and review across Genetec, C-CURE, Milestone, Avigilon, Axis, and Bosch. The
system and the network it runs on, treated as one problem.

Learn more → ][66][

### Physical Security Design

Design and gap assessment for access control, CCTV, and integrated physical security. From threat
model to a specification an integrator can build to.

Learn more → ][67][

### Enterprise Network Architecture

Most platform problems are network problems wearing a costume. Topology, segmentation, routing, and
wireless designed properly from the start, not bolted on later.

Learn more → ][68][

### Industrial and OT Networks

Segmentation, the iDMZ, passive monitoring, and secure remote access applied in a way that respects
how plant systems actually run.

Learn more → ][69][

### Data Centre and Cabling

Physical-layer work is cheap to fix at design and expensive after construction. Pre-construction
review catches it before it becomes an installed fact.

Learn more → ][70][

### ICAT Design and Project Advisory

Integrated facility systems advisory, owner's representative services, and commissioning oversight
for complex physical security and technology projects.

Learn more → ][71][

### Mentorship and Technical Guidance

For integrators on complex bids and practitioners closing a knowledge gap. An independent technical
voice on a project already in progress.

Learn more → ][72]
[All engineering →][73]

// ADVISORY

## Senior security judgement, when the decision matters.

The leadership and strategy side. Fractional CISO, security and technology strategy, defence supply

you but the advice.

[

### Fractional CISO and vCISO

Retained, part-time security leadership for organizations without a full-time CISO. Strategy, board
reporting, program ownership, risk, and incident oversight.

Learn more → ][74][

### Strategic Security and Technology

Independent strategy for the decisions that are expensive to reverse. Roadmaps, architecture
direction, platform selection, and due diligence. Project-based and vendor-neutral.

Learn more → ][75][

### CMMC and CPCSC Readiness

Scoping, gap assessment, and attestation support for Canadian and cross-border defence suppliers.

The physical, OT, and IT boundary, assessed and secured by someone who reads both sides. Where a lot

// ABOUT HANS STUDY

## Technical depth across multiple disciplines.

I started the way a lot of people in this field do. Fixing computers for friends and family, then
picking up work installing small business networks and CCTV systems. By 2010 that had grown into my
own IT firm. What followed over the next fifteen years is where the depth comes from.

I have spent my career working across public sector, defence, public safety, and critical
infrastructure environments, designing and integrating the technology those organizations depend on.
That includes years working directly in the federal space on mission-critical networks where failure
was not an option.

That depth led to teaching at the post-secondary level. Cisco CCNA, Introductory and Advanced
Networking, Information Security, and Microsoft Windows Server and Workstation. Teaching is where
you find out how well you actually understand something. Mentoring practitioners and integrators is
still part of the work today.

Today I consult independently across Canada and the United States on enterprise networks, OT and ICS
security, physical security systems, and ICAT design. The technical writing and the tools on this
site come out of that consulting work, not the other way around.

* CISSP, Certified Information Systems Security Professional

// ABOUT HANS STUDY

## Technical depth across multiple disciplines.

I started the way a lot of people in this field do. Fixing computers for friends and family, then
picking up work installing small business networks and CCTV systems. By 2010 that had grown into my
own IT firm. What followed over the next fifteen years is where the depth comes from.

I have spent my career working across public sector, defence, public safety, and critical
infrastructure environments, designing and integrating the technology those organizations depend on.
That includes years working directly in the federal space on mission-critical networks where failure
was not an option.

That depth led to teaching at the post-secondary level. Cisco CCNA, Introductory and Advanced
Networking, Information Security, and Microsoft Windows Server and Workstation. Teaching is where
you find out how well you actually understand something. Mentoring practitioners and integrators is
still part of the work today.

Today I consult independently across Canada and the United States on enterprise networks, OT and ICS
security, physical security systems, and ICAT design. The technical writing and the tools on this
site come out of that consulting work, not the other way around.

### Ultimate safety and reliability

Liveness detection technology effectively resists photo, video, and mask attacks; unique identity
binding eliminates proxy swiping and impersonation; strict permission management and real-time alarm
mechanism build a security barrier.

### Unfeeling smooth experience

Face/fingerprint verification in seconds, say goodbye to the tediousness of searching for cards and
entering passwords; contactless access is more hygienic; greatly shortens the waiting time during
peak hours and improves personnel satisfaction.

### Cost reduction

Reduce the cost of manual duty; reduce the cost of card production and management; improve traffic
efficiency, which is equivalent to improving space utilization; prevent potential losses caused by
safety accidents.

### Strong compatibility

Support flexible combination of multiple biometric identification methods (face, fingerprint, palm
vein, etc.); open device interface, easy to integrate with existing systems (such as attendance,
elevator control, parking system); adapt to different scales and application scenarios.

### Stable and durable

Industrial-grade hardware design, adaptable to various environments; 7x24 hours stable operation;
provide professional installation, training and timely response after-sales service to ensure
long-term stable operation of the system.

### Intelligent management

Cloud platform centralized control, batch permission setting, remote equipment operation and
maintenance; detailed access records and data analysis provide data support for personnel
attendance, visitor management.

binding eliminates proxy swiping and impersonation; strict permission management and real-time alarm
mechanism build a security barrier.

### Unfeeling smooth experience

Face/fingerprint verification in seconds, say goodbye to the tediousness of searching for cards and
entering passwords; contactless access is more hygienic; greatly shortens the waiting time during
peak hours and improves personnel satisfaction.

### Cost reduction

Reduce the cost of manual duty; reduce the cost of card production and management; improve traffic
efficiency, which is equivalent to improving space utilization; prevent potential losses caused by
safety accidents.

### Strong compatibility

Support flexible combination of multiple biometric identification methods (face, fingerprint, palm
vein, etc.); open device interface, easy to integrate with existing systems (such as attendance,
elevator control, parking system); adapt to different scales and application scenarios.

### Stable and durable

Industrial-grade hardware design, adaptable to various environments; 7x24 hours stable operation;
provide professional installation, training and timely response after-sales service to ensure
long-term stable operation of the system.

### Intelligent management

Cloud platform centralized control, batch permission setting, remote equipment operation and
maintenance; detailed access records and data analysis provide data support for personnel
attendance, visitor management.

high-resolution cameras, intelligent video analytics, and improved low-light performance. These
advancements have transcended the traditional role of surveillance systems, evolving into proactive
tools for threat detection and incident prevention. As businesses, organizations, and communities
prioritize safety and security, integrating these technologies into comprehensive surveillance
strategies is no longer an option but a necessity. By leveraging the power of high-resolution
imagery, data interpretation, and enhanced visibility, modern video surveillance technology is
shaping a safer and more secure world.

# **AllClear by inFRONT helps guide high-hazard sites on their journey to ****100% emergency
# mustering accountability**

[SCHEDULE A DEMO][19]

### **100% in 15 minutes**

 Using proven processes and systems, you’ll be able to account for 100% of your personnel, fast,
with real-time employee mustering data.

### **Avoid tragic results**

Knowing exactly who’s in your high-hazard units through accurate emergency mustering can save lives
in case of an incident.

### **Save time and money**

Replacing traditional inefficient methods with mustering tools means more accurate accountability,
PSM compliance, and time on tools.

## Every day you delay is another day of unnecessary risk

All too often you don’t have accurate data to know who’s on-site, where they are, and whether they
are qualified to be there. Without reliable mustering data, being caught unprepared during an
incident exposes everyone on site to unreasonable risk and possible tragedy.

### Solutions for every aspect of emergency readiness

## AllClear for Mustering

AllClear provides up-to-the-second mustering data and empowers emergency responders to act quickly
when emergencies happen.

[MUSTERING][20]

## AllClear for Unit Accountability

Improve safety, time on tools, and regulatory compliance with Unit Accountability that really works,
fully integrated with your mustering processes

[UNIT ACCOUNTABILITY][21]

## AllClear Equipped

Feel confident your equipment is ready with our emergency response equipment readiness software.

[AllClear EQUIPPED][22]

## AllClear for Turnarounds

Account for all personnel on your site during turnarounds, shutdowns, and construction projects with
precise, real-time employee and contractor mustering capabilities.

[TURNAROUNDS][23]

## **Are you ready to get to 100% in 15 minutes? Here’s how. **

**Schedule a call to walk through your current mustering process**
Talk to one of our AllClear specialists.

**Build stakeholder support**
Getting a budget can be hard. We can help.

**Implement AllClear**
We’ll be there from engagement through your first emergency mustering drill.

**Account for your people now**
Start accounting for everyone on your site.

[SCHEDULE A DEMO][24]

### **100% with the best in the business**

Accounting for people on high-hazard sites through advanced industrial mustering solutions is all we
do, and we’ve been doing it longer than anyone.

### **Dozens of organizations use AllClear, including **

#### One of the largest refineries in North America

#### The top two chemical companies in the world

With our proven success accounting for 100% of personnel in multiple real-life incidents, you can
count on us to help you be ready to save lives in an emergency.

## Trusted by organizations like yours

[Shell logo]

# Your competitors are getting calls from Google.
# *You’re not.*

The problem

## Most tradespeople are invisible in local search.

When someone in your area searches for a plumber, an electrician, or a heating engineer, **three
businesses show up in the Google Maps local pack**. One of them gets the call.

If you’re not in that map pack, you don’t exist.

The tradespeople ranking at the top aren’t necessarily better at the job than you. They’ve just got
their local SEO sorted. Their Google Business Profile is complete, their reviews are fresh, and
their website backs it all up.

Most tradespeople rely on word of mouth because they don’t know how to change this, or don’t have
the time. Work dries up in the quiet months and there’s nothing online to fill the gap.

**That’s what I fix.**

Proof of concept

## I built this system on my own businesses before offering it to anyone.

Before I took on a single client, I ran the same process on my own businesses. The Google Business
Profile work, the citation build, the on-page content targeting local search. I wanted to know
exactly what moved and how fast before asking anyone else to trust it.

months of SEO work] Keyword · “AI Automation Consultant UK” · Position 100+ to number 1 over 3
months

I run local SEO on my own businesses the same way I’d run it for yours. If it doesn’t work for me, I
don’t sell it.

you in missed jobs.

Step 02

### Book a 20-minute call

I’ll walk through the report with you and tell you exactly what needs to change. No pressure, no
pitch. Just a straight conversation about your situation.

Step 03

### I handle everything

If it makes sense to work together, I manage your local SEO every month. You don’t log in anywhere
or learn anything new. You focus on the work; I make sure the phone keeps ringing.

What you get

## Done-for-you local SEO, every month

One monthly fee. Everything included. Here’s what I manage:

### Google Business Profile

Your Google Business Profile is the single most important factor for appearing in the local pack on
Google Maps. I set it up properly, keep it active with posts and photos every month, and lock it so
nothing unexpected changes.

[Learn more about GBP management →][10]

### Google Reviews

Every completed job triggers an automatic review request to your customer. When Google reviews come
in, they’re responded to automatically. More reviews, better rating, stronger local search ranking.

[Learn more about review management →][11]

### Local Citations

Your business listed accurately across 53+ UK directories: Apple Maps, Bing Places, Yell, Yelp, and
more, plus trade-specific sites like Checkatrade and TrustATrader. Consistent name, address, and
phone number across every platform Google checks.

[Learn more about citation building →][12]

### Website Content

I write and publish the pages your site needs to rank in local search: a homepage targeting your
main trade, category pages for each service type, and individual service pages for every job you do.
All of it built to back up your Google Business Profile.

[Learn more about website content →][13]

### Monthly Reporting

Every month you get a local SEO heat map showing where you rank across your service area, plus a

[Learn more about reporting →][14]

**One extra job a month more than covers it.**

If you charge £2,500 for a boiler installation, one extra job covers five months of this service. If
you do rewires at £3,500, one extra job covers seven months.

The maths isn’t complicated. The question is whether you’re picking up those jobs now, or someone
else is.
* Google Business Profile setup and ongoing management
* Review automation: requests and responses
* Citation build across 53+ UK directories
* Website: 30+ pages written and published over months 1 and 2
* Monthly local SEO heat map report and client summary
* Ongoing content and rank-driven updates from month 3

[Get your free visibility report][16]
I’m taking on **10 founding clients** at this price. Once I have case studies and results to show,
the price moves to £797/month. If you’re reading this now, you’re still in time to lock in £497.
Optional add-on

Need a new website from scratch? I build clean, fast, mobile-ready sites for **£1,500 one-time**,
including hosting.

Questions

## Straight answers

How long does local SEO take to work?
Month one is the foundation: Google Business Profile, citations, website pages, review system. You
may see early movement in weeks, but local search rankings compound over time. Most clients see
meaningful movement from month three. Local SEO isn’t instant; it’s cumulative. The tradespeople who
stick with it past six months stop worrying about where the next job is coming from.
What if I already have a website?
Good. I work with existing sites and don’t need to replace yours. I’ll review it and work with what
you’ve got. If it’s too thin or broken to be useful, I’ll tell you and you can decide whether to use
my website add-on.
What trades do you work with?
Plumbers, heating engineers, electricians, security system installers, solar installers, EV charger
installers, builders, roofers, joiners, plasterers, tilers, and most other UK trade businesses. If
your customers search Google to find someone like you, local SEO works for you.
How is this different from what I’ve tried before?

Most agencies do one thing, usually a website or some basic SEO, and leave the rest. I cover the
whole picture: Google Business Profile, citations, reviews, website, and content, all managed
together every month. That’s why it works when piecemeal approaches don’t.

I also don’t lock you in. If you’re not seeing results and you want to leave, you can. I’d rather
earn your business every month than hold you to a contract.

What do I need to do?
Very little. Once I’ve got your basic details and access to your Google account, I handle
everything. There’s no dashboard to log in to, no tasks landing in your inbox. A quick sign-off on
the monthly report is all I ask.
Can I cancel?
Yes. No minimum contract, no cancellation fees. I ask for 30 days’ notice so I can wrap things up
cleanly.

Local SEO for UK Tradespeople

# Your competitors are getting calls from Google.
# *You’re not.*

I manage your Google Business Profile, local search rankings, reviews, website, and directory
listings every month so your phone rings with local jobs. You focus on the work. I make sure the
enquiries keep coming.

[ Get your free visibility report ][8] [ See how it works ][9]

Takes 3 minutes. No obligation. I’ll show you exactly where you stand.

**AWARD WINNING: Best Rated SEO Agency, Peterborough**

The problem

## Most tradespeople are invisible in local search.

When someone in your area searches for a plumber, an electrician, or a heating engineer, **three
businesses show up in the Google Maps local pack**. One of them gets the call.

If you’re not in that map pack, you don’t exist.

The tradespeople ranking at the top aren’t necessarily better at the job than you. They’ve just got
their local SEO sorted. Their Google Business Profile is complete, their reviews are fresh, and
their website backs it all up.

Most tradespeople rely on word of mouth because they don’t know how to change this, or don’t have
the time. Work dries up in the quiet months and there’s nothing online to fill the gap.

**That’s what I fix.**

Proof of concept

## I built this system on my own businesses before offering it to anyone.

Before I took on a single client, I ran the same process on my own businesses. The Google Business
Profile work, the citation build, the on-page content targeting local search. I wanted to know
exactly what moved and how fast before asking anyone else to trust it.

Here’s what the rankings looked like.

[Line graph showing a local search keyword moving from position 15 to position 1 over six months of
SEO work][Line graph showing a local search keyword moving from position 15 to position 1 over six
months of SEO work] Keyword · “AI Automation Consultant UK” · Position 100+ to number 1 over 3
months

I run local SEO on my own businesses the same way I’d run it for yours. If it doesn’t work for me, I
don’t sell it.

The process

## Here’s what happens

Step 01

### Get your free report

Answer a few quick questions about your business. I’ll send you a personalised Local Visibility
Report showing exactly where you rank in local search, where the gaps are, and what they’re costing
you in missed jobs.

Step 02

### Book a 20-minute call

I’ll walk through the report with you and tell you exactly what needs to change. No pressure, no
pitch. Just a straight conversation about your situation.

Step 03

### I handle everything

If it makes sense to work together, I manage your local SEO every month. You don’t log in anywhere
or learn anything new. You focus on the work; I make sure the phone keeps ringing.

What you get

## Done-for-you local SEO, every month

One monthly fee. Everything included. Here’s what I manage:

### Google Business Profile

Your Google Business Profile is the single most important factor for appearing in the local pack on
Google Maps. I set it up properly, keep it active with posts and photos every month, and lock it so
nothing unexpected changes.

[Learn more about GBP management →][10]

### Google Reviews

Every completed job triggers an automatic review request to your customer. When Google reviews come
in, they’re responded to automatically. More reviews, better rating, stronger local search ranking.

[Learn more about review management →][11]

### Local Citations

Your business listed accurately across 53+ UK directories: Apple Maps, Bing Places, Yell, Yelp, and
more, plus trade-specific sites like Checkatrade and TrustATrader. Consistent name, address, and
phone number across every platform Google checks.

[Learn more about citation building →][12]

### Website Content

I write and publish the pages your site needs to rank in local search: a homepage targeting your
main trade, category pages for each service type, and individual service pages for every job you do.
All of it built to back up your Google Business Profile.

[Learn more about website content →][13]

### Monthly Reporting

Every month you get a local SEO heat map showing where you rank across your service area, plus a
plain-English summary of what moved, what I did, and what’s planned for next month.

[Learn more about reporting →][14]

### Ongoing Management

From month two: new pages added based on ranking data, content published where local visibility is

Pricing

## What it costs

Founding Client Offer
£ 497
per month
No setup fee. No minimum contract. Cancel any time.

**One extra job a month more than covers it.**

If you charge £2,500 for a boiler installation, one extra job covers five months of this service. If
you do rewires at £3,500, one extra job covers seven months.

The maths isn’t complicated. The question is whether you’re picking up those jobs now, or someone
else is.
* Google Business Profile setup and ongoing management
* Review automation: requests and responses
* Citation build across 53+ UK directories
* Website: 30+ pages written and published over months 1 and 2
* Monthly local SEO heat map report and client summary
* Ongoing content and rank-driven updates from month 3

[Get your free visibility report][16]
I’m taking on **10 founding clients** at this price. Once I have case studies and results to show,
the price moves to £797/month. If you’re reading this now, you’re still in time to lock in £497.
Optional add-on

Need a new website from scratch? I build clean, fast, mobile-ready sites for **£1,500 one-time**,
including hosting.

Questions

## Straight answers

How long does local SEO take to work?
Month one is the foundation: Google Business Profile, citations, website pages, review system. You
may see early movement in weeks, but local search rankings compound over time. Most clients see
meaningful movement from month three. Local SEO isn’t instant; it’s cumulative. The tradespeople who
stick with it past six months stop worrying about where the next job is coming from.
What if I already have a website?
Good. I work with existing sites and don’t need to replace yours. I’ll review it and work with what
you’ve got. If it’s too thin or broken to be useful, I’ll tell you and you can decide whether to use
my website add-on.
What trades do you work with?
Plumbers, heating engineers, electricians, security system installers, solar installers, EV charger
installers, builders, roofers, joiners, plasterers, tilers, and most other UK trade businesses. If
your customers search Google to find someone like you, local SEO works for you.
How is this different from what I’ve tried before?

Most agencies do one thing, usually a website or some basic SEO, and leave the rest. I cover the
whole picture: Google Business Profile, citations, reviews, website, and content, all managed
together every month. That’s why it works when piecemeal approaches don’t.

I also don’t lock you in. If you’re not seeing results and you want to leave, you can. I’d rather
earn your business every month than hold you to a contract.

What do I need to do?
Very little. Once I’ve got your basic details and access to your Google account, I handle
everything. There’s no dashboard to log in to, no tasks landing in your inbox. A quick sign-off on
the monthly report is all I ask.
Can I cancel?
Yes. No minimum contract, no cancellation fees. I ask for 30 days’ notice so I can wrap things up
cleanly.
Get started

## Find out where you stand in local search

Answer a few quick questions and I’ll send you a free Local Visibility Report: a straight look at
where your business appears on Google, what your local competitors are doing, and what it’s costing
you in missed jobs.

[Get your free report][17]

Takes 3 minutes. No obligation. No sales call unless you want one.

Cyber Security

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

# PDF Accessibility CheckerIs my PDF accessible?

The free PAC PDF Accessibility Checker helps you assess your documents

[Download PAC 2026][10]

## PAC 2026 is here – now with AI checks

PAC 2026 expands existing tests with [AI-assisted checks][11] that significantly reduce the amount
of manual testing required.

 

**PAC is funded by the German Federal Ministry of Labor and Social Affairs.**

[Learn more about the funding.][12]

## Organizations using PAC
* [[Logo Parliament of Austria]][13]
* [[Logo Bundesagentur für Arbeit]][14]
* [[Logo Technical University Chemnitz]][15]
* [[Logo Swiss Federal Government]][16]

## Checks with artificial intelligence

Here you will find all the information you need about AI-supported checks in PAC 2026.

[AI-checks][17]

## Why PAC?

PAC is the globally used, free PDF accessibility checking tool that has been tried and tested since
2010. PAC can check many PDF/UA and WCAG requirements at the touch of a button. In addition to this,
PAC also supports the required visual check.

### Checks for PDF/UA and WCAG conformity

PAC supports the two most widely recognized document accessibility standards in the world.

### Technical accessibility can be assessed in seconds

Drag and drop your file onto the user interface and see the result instantly.

### Intuitive to operate

Easy-to-use functions and views make checking a document child's play.

### Simplifies manual testing

The screen reader and structure preview allows a sighted user to visually see what the screen reader
will read, the structure and order.

### Result available as a summary or detailed report

Choose between the summary and the detailed report identifying where errors occur.

### No admin rights required 

After downloading, simply launch the PAC installation and you're ready to start checking. No admin
rights are needed. 

## Free webinar: Getting started with PAC

Regularly, we organize free online seminars in which we present the new functions of PAC 2024.
Register to ask questions and receive tips and tricks.

Register for the next online seminars for free by clicking on the button below.

[View all events][18]

## Why are accessible documents important?

To achieve an inclusive working world and information society, information needs to be consistently
and reliably provided in a barrier-free form. This enables people with disabilities to have equal
and independent access to all information.

In addition to accessibility being both an ethical and legal requirement, accessible documents offer
further advantages:
* **Use in the mobile web:** Ideal for displaying even on small screens such as smartphones.
* **Google loves them:** The rich semantics of content leads to better indexing by search engines.
* **Future-proof:** Accessible content is prepared for intelligent reuse (rich data, AI, other
  evaluations, conversion to other formats).

# PDF Accessibility CheckerIs my PDF accessible?

The free PAC PDF Accessibility Checker helps you assess your documents

[Download PAC 2026][10]

## PAC 2026 is here – now with AI checks

PAC 2026 expands existing tests with [AI-assisted checks][11] that significantly reduce the amount
of manual testing required.

 

**PAC is funded by the German Federal Ministry of Labor and Social Affairs.**

[Learn more about the funding.][12]

## Organizations using PAC
* [[Logo Parliament of Austria]][13]
* [[Logo Bundesagentur für Arbeit]][14]
* [[Logo Technical University Chemnitz]][15]
* [[Logo Swiss Federal Government]][16]

## Checks with artificial intelligence

Here you will find all the information you need about AI-supported checks in PAC 2026.

[AI-checks][17]

## Why PAC?

PAC is the globally used, free PDF accessibility checking tool that has been tried and tested since
2010. PAC can check many PDF/UA and WCAG requirements at the touch of a button. In addition to this,
PAC also supports the required visual check.

### Checks for PDF/UA and WCAG conformity

PAC supports the two most widely recognized document accessibility standards in the world.

### Technical accessibility can be assessed in seconds

Drag and drop your file onto the user interface and see the result instantly.

### Intuitive to operate

Easy-to-use functions and views make checking a document child's play.

### Simplifies manual testing

The screen reader and structure preview allows a sighted user to visually see what the screen reader
will read, the structure and order.

### Result available as a summary or detailed report

Choose between the summary and the detailed report identifying where errors occur.

### No admin rights required 

After downloading, simply launch the PAC installation and you're ready to start checking. No admin
rights are needed. 

## Free webinar: Getting started with PAC

Regularly, we organize free online seminars in which we present the new functions of PAC 2024.
Register to ask questions and receive tips and tricks.

Register for the next online seminars for free by clicking on the button below.

[View all events][18]

## Why are accessible documents important?

To achieve an inclusive working world and information society, information needs to be consistently
and reliably provided in a barrier-free form. This enables people with disabilities to have equal
and independent access to all information.

In addition to accessibility being both an ethical and legal requirement, accessible documents offer
further advantages:
* **Use in the mobile web:** Ideal for displaying even on small screens such as smartphones.
* **Google loves them:** The rich semantics of content leads to better indexing by search engines.
* **Future-proof:** Accessible content is prepared for intelligent reuse (rich data, AI, other
  evaluations, conversion to other formats).

## What users say about PAC

> Kathryn Collins, ADSAccessible Document Specialist | Founder of KC & the Graphics Bandwagon
> (Australia)
> "axes4's PAC desktop accessibility checker is one of my daily go-to's in my accessibility
> toolkit."
> [Person on LinkedIn][19]

> Chad CheliusPrincipal – Chax Training and Consulting (USA)
> "The PAC Checker provides an even more robust method to check documents against known standards.
> With an improved color contrast checker and the addition of the Quality report, I can feel
> confident that my files are fully compliant to both WCAG and PDF/UA standards."
> [Person on LinkedIn][20][Person on X (Twitter)][21]

performs three crucial tests in one unit – freeze point, viscosity and density. And, it does it all
in less than 15 minutes!
[link][144]

### OptiDist 2

Engineered for superior performance, precision, and reliability, the OptiDist 2 is the next
generation of the industry-leading atmospheric distillation benchmark with a redesigned cooling
system and advanced optimization technology.
[link][145]

Designed as standard GC solution with the flexibility for custom modifications to address precise
testing needs.

The World’s Most Reliable Security Architecture. The patented Fault Tolerant (FT) Access Controller.

## Case Studies

From large to small properties, PCSC’s access solutions are scalable and dynamic.

[View Case Studies][84]

## Training Classes

Success begins with knowing the PCSC products. Get the knowledge you need from our product experts.

## Apples to Oranges

Not all access controllers are created equal. What makes us competitive?

[Download the PDF][86]

### [Cloud-based Access][87]

Enabling easy-to-use cloud-based access control LiNC-NXG Browser Enabled is an add-on option to the
standard full LiNC-NXG desktop solution. An easy to use browser enabled interface allows the
managing of essential common functions for cardholders, time periods, authorization groups, locking
and unlocking of doors and more. [Cloud-based Access][88]

 

### Introducing the New IQ Pro Access Controller

##### **The latest in multi-configurable access controllers are PCSC’s iQ Pro Series. A benchmark
##### for access control, input and output control monitoring.
##### **

[Download the PDF][89]

### PCSC at a Glance

* [Access Control Leaders][90]
  
  PCSC is a leader in access control. Innovators of high-tech solutions for the security industry
  since 1983. From inception to today, PCSC has introduced many firsts in the industry such as
  integrated video badging, Wiegand reader distances up to 2000 feet, fully intelligent elevator
  controls, direct Ethernet LAN based panels, and recently the industry’s first truly Fault
  Tolerant, patented access control system.
* [About PCSC][91]
  
  Headquartered in Torrance, California, PCSC is a designer and manufacturer of quality access
  control solutions. From integrated hardware to sophisticated access control management software,
  including: door entry access, video badging, CCTV control, elevator control, alarm graphics,
  perimeter, pipeline and underwater detection systems, and video event recording. With a full-line
  of wired and wireless intelligent controllers, Fault Tolerant systems and multiple card reader
  technologies to choose from.

# About us

Since company establishment in 1988, PERCo major activity has been the development and serial
production of security systems and equipment. Now the high quality of PERCo products is recognised
throughout the industry in 96 countries worldwide.

PERCo quality management system is certified in accordance with the ISO 9001:2015 international
standard.

The warranty period for all PERCo products is 5 years from the date of sale. Thanks to the
state-of-the-art production facilities and the use of innovative technologies, PERCo designs,
manufactures and successfully markets products that meet international standards of the security
industry.

Niche tools feel great - quick to set up and easy to use. But as your company grows, they become a
scattered mix that no longer works together.
Big "all-in-one" platforms aren’t a silver bullet. On paper they do everything, but in real life
they’re shallow and fail on complex workflows.
Sooner or later you see the pattern: the usual approach caps your growth. You need a system that
unifies workflows and grows with your business.

## Alright, So What Gives Planfix Its Edge, Even When Stacked Up Against All Those All-in-One
## Systems?

### Typical all-in-one systems?

They're like a bunch of separate apps or building blocks, each handling a different job — think
project management, CRM, HelpDesk, or even keeping track of the finances.

### Planfix is the real deal, the whole enchilada, an all-in-one system for managing teamwork built
### around your business.

Thanks to its [unique philosophy][64], Planfix grows and evolves with your company. You won't find
two trees in the world that are exactly the same — and you won't find two Planfix systems that are
identical either.

Planfix scripts react to events and automatically do what needs doing: they create tasks, generate
reports, and distribute documents.

## Everyone Sees Only What They Need for Their Work — No More, No Less.

Planfix has an uber-flexible data access rights system. Each staff member and department works with
what they need, and the bosses see the big picture. Plus, you'll find corporate-level tools for
monitoring and access control here.

Data Tags are a unique tool in Planfix; there's nothing quite like it out there.

communication.

**Full Service Security**

**Premises Control is a full-service security integration firm dedicated to long-term client
partnerships.**

[See Our Services][16]

Premises Control, Inc. is a full-service security firm, with clients ranging from medium sized
businesses to enterprise-sized organizations. By partnering with our clients before, during, and
after installation, we work hard to ensure seamless operation and complete satisfaction. Rather than
offer many brands, we focus on having deep knowledge in a few industry leading technology
developers. We have extensive knowledge in each supported solution. Our suite of capabilities
includes access control, CCTV, intrusion detection and intercom communications, providing the
protection you need without compromise.

## Industrial

Using video surveillance to observe production equipment and staff movement improves safety by
identifying potential safety hazards and unsafe behavior.  Securing tool rooms, robotic production
areas and engineering offices is simple using access control and video monitoring.

## Distribution and Logistics

Warehousing operations require the seamless flow of valuable inventory while reducing theft and
damage. By deploying AI-powered video analytics through IP video systems, managers can proactively
monitor and receive alerts on unusual product movement, unsafe behavior, and bottlenecks that hinder
productivity.

## Higher Education

Amid recent campus unrest, higher education security teams are intensifying their surveillance of
public spaces where gatherings could quickly escalate. By deploying AI-driven IP video systems,
campus security managers can detect potential threats early and take swift action before situations
worsen. When integrated with access control, rapid lockdown procedures are simplified whether for a
single building or the entire campus helping ensure the safety of students, faculty, and staff.

## Commercial

Single-tenant and multi-tenant office complexes benefit significantly from integrated access control
solutions. By coupling visitor management with access control, security administrators can swiftly
grant or revoke permissions for visitors and contractors, all from a centralized platform. Further
integrations—such as elevator controls—help secure sensitive areas, providing an additional layer of
protection by ensuring only authorized personnel have the clearance to access restricted floors.

## Healthcare

Healthcare facilities face unique security challenges, as they must allow seamless movement for
patients, staff, and visitors while protecting critical areas like ER’s, pharmacies, and procedure
rooms. Premises Control addresses these needs by designing, implementing, and supporting integrated
access control and video monitoring solutions across ambulatory surgery centers, medical practices,
and hospitals.

## Utilities

Utilities, as mission-critical infrastructure, demand continuous monitoring while maintaining strict
FERC and NERC compliance. At Premises Control, our team brings extensive experience in designing,
installing, and staffing Security Operation Centers (SOCs) specifically for utility environments. We
also support integrated physical security systems for geographically dispersed sites, ensuring
comprehensive coverage and regulatory adherence.

A ticket can be submitted online if you are having issues. A Premises Control representative will

###### Solutions

## Smarter Access Control Powered by Insyte Security

Insyte Security delivers end-to-end access control solutions throughout Florida using
industry-trusted Proptia technology. As licensed access control dealers and one of the leading
Proptia dealers nationally, we specialize in designing, installing, and supporting advanced systems
for HOAs, commercial properties, and developers across the state.

[img]
[img]

### [Bluetooth & Mobile Entry][35]

Allow residents and staff to open gates with their phones—no remotes or access cards needed.

[img]
[img]

### [Smart Gate & Visitor Management][36]

Screen guests, manage delivery vendors, and maintain clear entry logs across all gates and doors.

[img]
[img]

### [Cloud-Controlled Credentialing][37]

Create digital QR codes, badges, and time-sensitive passes that let the right people in at the right
time.

[img]
[img]

### [License Plate Recognition (LPR)][38]

Automate entry by scanning approved vehicles, reducing wait times at busy gates.

[img]
[img]

### [Remote Admin Dashboard][39]

Control permissions, view activity, and update access from your phone or desktop.

[img]
[img]

### [Contractor Access Control Tools][40]

Grant limited access to trades, cleaners, landscapers, and vendors with expiration rules and
tracking.

[View All Services ][41]

###### Clients & Partnerships

## Who These Systems
## Work Best For

Whether you're running an HOA, managing a commercial site, or developing a mixed-use property, our
certified access control contractors design each system around your unique layout, traffic, and
security goals.
* HOAs & Gated Communities
  
  #### HOAs & Gated Communities
  
  Tired of relying on outdated entry systems, manual codes, or physical keys? Insyte’s Proptia
  Florida network gives your residents a smoother experience while you get complete oversight and
  fewer complaints.
* Commercial Property Managers
  
  
  Simplify access across office parks, retail complexes, or warehouses. Grant timed entry, monitor
  logs, and centralize control with no on-site server.
* Developers & Builders
  
  
  Integrate smart access control into your new construction project with help from certified access
  control contractors. We’ll coordinate with your team during planning and handle installation at
  the right stage of your build.
* Vendors, Trades & Contractors

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.
