[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you

## Wir sind Spezialisten für Multi-Access-Systeme und Cloud-Lösungen

### Was sind die Vorteile von Multi-Access-Systemen gegenüber klassischen Sicherheitssystemen?

Multi-Access-Systeme bieten im Vergleich zu klassischen Sicherheitssystemen zahlreiche Vorteile. Sie
ermöglichen eine zentrale und flexible Verwaltung von Zutrittsberechtigungen, wodurch Anpassungen in
Echtzeit vorgenommen werden können. Durch den Einsatz fortschrittlicher Authentifizierungsmethoden
wie biometrischer Erkennung oder mobiler Zugriffsmedien wird die Sicherheit auf ein höheres Niveau
gehoben. Zudem bieten diese Systeme umfassende Reporting- und Analysefunktionen, die detaillierte
Einblicke in Zugriffsaktivitäten und Sicherheitsvorfälle liefern. Darüber hinaus reduzieren sie
durch ihre Skalierbarkeit und Integration mit anderen Sicherheitstechnologien die
Gesamtbetriebskosten und den Verwaltungsaufwand, was sie zu einer kosteneffizienten und
zukunftssicheren Lösung macht.

### Wie können Cloud-Lösungen die Sicherheit der Systeme verbessern?

**Verbesserte Sicherheitsprotokolle:** Sie profitieren von modernen Sicherheitsmaßnahmen wie
Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung und regelmäßigen Updates, die oft über die internen
Möglichkeiten hinausgehen.
**Skalierbare Sicherheitsressourcen:** Die Flexibilität der Cloud ermöglicht es, Sicherheitslösungen
gezielt an die spezifischen Anforderungen und die Größe Ihrer Systeme anzupassen.
**Proaktive Bedrohungserkennung:** Mit ständig aktualisierten Bedrohungsdatenbanken und
KI-gestützten Analysetools können potenzielle Risiken frühzeitig erkannt und effektiv gemanagt
werden.
**Zentralisierte Sicherheitsverwaltung:** Eine zentrale Plattform zur Übersicht und Verwaltung Ihrer
Sicherheitsmaßnahmen ermöglicht eine konsistente und effiziente Sicherheitsstrategie.
**Robuste Backup- und Wiederherstellungslösungen:** Umfassende Backup-Optionen und schnelle
Wiederherstellung garantieren den Schutz und die Wiederherstellung Ihrer Daten im Falle eines
Ausfalls oder Vorfalls.

## Smart. Innovativ. Zukunftssicher.

Unsere Leistungen umfassen Brandmeldesysteme, Einbruchmeldeanlagen, Videoüberwachung,
Zutrittskontrolle und weitere sicherheitstechnische Lösungen. Unsere Sicherheitssysteme helfen Ihnen
nicht nur dabei Risiken zu minimieren, sondern unterstützen auch die Einhaltung gesetzlicher
Vorgaben und Industriestandards. Darüber hinaus setzen wir auf innovative Cloud-Lösungen, die eine
flexible und zukunftssichere Sicherheitsinfrastruktur gewährleisten.
* ### Videoüberwachung
  
  Unsere Videoüberwachungslösungen bieten Ihnen eine detaillierte und kontinuierliche Überwachung
  Ihrer Anlagen. Mit modernster Bildtechnologie und intelligenten Analysefunktionen sichern wir Ihre
  Geschäftsbereiche rund um die Uhr.
  
  [Erfahre mehr][22]
* ### Zutrittskontrolle
  
  Optimieren Sie den Zugang zu Ihren Räumlichkeiten mit unseren Zutrittskontrollsystemen. Unsere
  Lösungen ermöglichen eine präzise Steuerung und Überwachung des Zugangs, um Ihre
  Sicherheitsanforderungen zuverlässig zu erfüllen.
  
  [Erfahre mehr][23]
* ### Brandmeldesysteme
  
  Unsere Brandmeldesysteme bieten Ihnen umfassenden Schutz durch modernste Technologien und
  zuverlässige Frühwarnsysteme. Wir gewährleisten, dass Ihre Gebäude durch hochentwickelte
  Branddetektion und -meldung stets optimal abgesichert sind.
  
  [Erfahre mehr][24]
* ### Einbruchmeldeanlagen
  
  Mit unseren Einbruchmeldeanlagen schützen Sie Ihre Unternehmenswerte effektiv vor unbefugtem
  Zugriff. Unsere Lösungen bieten präzise Überwachung und schnelle Alarmierung, um
  Sicherheitsrisiken proaktiv zu minimieren.

## Ihre Vorteile

### Durch eine Partnerschaft mit SecFire:

### Zertifizierte Qualität

Unser Unternehmen ist nach ISO 9001, DIN 14675 und VDS 3403 zertifiziert und bietet somit höchste
Standards in Qualität und Sicherheit. Besonders hervorzuheben ist unsere Präqualifizierung, die uns
als einen der wenigen Anbieter in der Branche auszeichnet und Ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit in der
Zusammenarbeit bietet.

### Langjährige Expertise

Mit 20 Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Sicherheitstechnik und über 10 Jahren im Bereich Physical
Security bieten wir tiefgreifendes Fachwissen und praxisorientierte Lösungen. Diese umfassende
Erfahrung ermöglicht es uns komplexe Herausforderungen effizient zu meistern.

### Qualifiziertes Personal

Unsere Dienstleistungen werden ausschließlich von hochqualifizierten Fachkräften erbracht. Im
Gegensatz zu vielen Wettbewerbern setzen wir keine Subunternehmer ein, damit wir eine konstante hohe
Servicequalität und Zuverlässigkeit garantieren können.

### Maßgeschneiderte Lösungen

Dank unseres vielfältigen Angebots und Zugangs zu verschiedenen Herstellern entwickeln wir
Sicherheitslösungen, die exakt auf Ihre Anforderungen zugeschnitten sind.

### Agile und effiziente Prozesse

Als agiles Unternehmen mit Erfahrungen aus 15 Jahren Konzerntätigkeit kombinieren wir die Vorteile
eines kleinen Unternehmens – schnelle Entscheidungswege und hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit – mit den
strukturierten und sicheren Prozessen eines Großunternehmens.

### Durchgehender Support

Unser 24/7 Service und Helpdesk stehen Ihnen jederzeit zur Verfügung. Ob bei technischen Fragen,
Notfällen oder Wartungsanfragen – wir sorgen dafür, dass Ihre Systeme stets sicher und reibungslos
funktionieren.

[Kontakt][26]

### Zertifizierungen und Qualifikationen

### Ein Unterschied, der sich auszahlt.

Unsere Zertifizierungen umfassen die** **DIN 14675** **für Brandmeldeanlagen, ISO 9001 für
Qualitätsmanagement und VDS 3403 für Einbruchmeldeanlagen. Zudem sind wir präqualifiziert für
öffentliche Aufträge. Diese Zertifizierungen belegen unsere Fachkompetenz und unser Engagement für
erstklassige Qualität. Sie differenzieren uns klar von vielen Mitbewerbern und bestätigen unsere
Position als zuverlässiger und professioneller Errichter für Sicherheitssysteme.

[Zertifikate ansehen][27]

## Wir sind Spezialisten für Multi-Access-Systeme und Cloud-Lösungen

### Was sind die Vorteile von Multi-Access-Systemen gegenüber klassischen Sicherheitssystemen?

Multi-Access-Systeme bieten im Vergleich zu klassischen Sicherheitssystemen zahlreiche Vorteile. Sie
ermöglichen eine zentrale und flexible Verwaltung von Zutrittsberechtigungen, wodurch Anpassungen in
Echtzeit vorgenommen werden können. Durch den Einsatz fortschrittlicher Authentifizierungsmethoden
wie biometrischer Erkennung oder mobiler Zugriffsmedien wird die Sicherheit auf ein höheres Niveau
gehoben. Zudem bieten diese Systeme umfassende Reporting- und Analysefunktionen, die detaillierte
Einblicke in Zugriffsaktivitäten und Sicherheitsvorfälle liefern. Darüber hinaus reduzieren sie
durch ihre Skalierbarkeit und Integration mit anderen Sicherheitstechnologien die
Gesamtbetriebskosten und den Verwaltungsaufwand, was sie zu einer kosteneffizienten und
zukunftssicheren Lösung macht.

### Wie können Cloud-Lösungen die Sicherheit der Systeme verbessern?

**Verbesserte Sicherheitsprotokolle:** Sie profitieren von modernen Sicherheitsmaßnahmen wie
Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung und regelmäßigen Updates, die oft über die internen
Möglichkeiten hinausgehen.
**Skalierbare Sicherheitsressourcen:** Die Flexibilität der Cloud ermöglicht es, Sicherheitslösungen
gezielt an die spezifischen Anforderungen und die Größe Ihrer Systeme anzupassen.
**Proaktive Bedrohungserkennung:** Mit ständig aktualisierten Bedrohungsdatenbanken und
KI-gestützten Analysetools können potenzielle Risiken frühzeitig erkannt und effektiv gemanagt
werden.
**Zentralisierte Sicherheitsverwaltung:** Eine zentrale Plattform zur Übersicht und Verwaltung Ihrer
Sicherheitsmaßnahmen ermöglicht eine konsistente und effiziente Sicherheitsstrategie.
**Robuste Backup- und Wiederherstellungslösungen:** Umfassende Backup-Optionen und schnelle
Wiederherstellung garantieren den Schutz und die Wiederherstellung Ihrer Daten im Falle eines
Ausfalls oder Vorfalls.

## Häufige Fragen

### Was unterscheidet Sie von anderen Errichtern für Sicherheitssysteme aus Deutschland?

Was uns von anderen Errichtern für Sicherheitssysteme** **in Deutschland unterscheidet, ist unsere
umfassende internationale Erfahrung, insbesondere mit US-Unternehmen und unsere erfolgreiche
Umsetzung von Projekten nach globalen Standards. Wir setzen auf bewährte Technologien und Produkte
renommierter Hersteller wie Genetec, Lenel, Avigilon und Brivo. Unsere Zertifizierungen nach ISO
9001, DIN 14675 und VDS 3403 sowie unsere Präqualifizierung garantieren höchste Qualität und
Sicherheit. Mit über 20 Jahren Erfahrung und einem Team von hochqualifizierten Fachkräften, bieten
wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen und kombinieren schnelle Entscheidungswege mit strukturierten
Prozessen, um anspruchsvolle Sicherheitslösungen effektiv und präzise zu realisieren.

Als Errichter für Sicherheitssysteme für Unternehmen aus den USA, die Produktionsstätten,
Bürogebäude, Lagerhäuser oder andere Einrichtungen in Deutschland betreiben, bieten wir umfassende
Expertise in der Implementierung und Integration führender Sicherheitslösungen von bevorzugten
Herstellern wie Genetec, Lenel, Avigilon und Brivo. Diese Anbieter sind weltweit anerkannt für ihre
hochentwickelten Systeme im Bereich Sicherheitsmanagement für Gebäude. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf
die Einhaltung aller relevanten Regularien und Sicherheitsstandards. Durch die erfolgreiche
Durchführung mehrerer Projekte für amerikanische Unternehmen haben wir ein tiefes Verständnis für
die spezifischen Anforderungen und regulatorischen Vorgaben. Dies ermöglicht uns, passende Lösungen
zu liefern, die sowohl die hohen Erwartungen unserer Kunden erfüllen als auch alle notwendigen
Compliance-Vorgaben sicherstellen.

### Wie läuft der Integrationsprozess eines neuen Sicherheitssystems ab?

**Planung:** In dieser Phase analysieren wir Ihre spezifischen Sicherheitsbedürfnisse und entwickeln

bestehender Infrastruktur und gesetzlicher Anforderungen, um eine umfassende und effektive Lösung zu
entwerfen.
**Ausführung:** Nach der Genehmigung des Plans beginnen wir mit der Implementierung des Systems.
Unser Team sorgt für die reibungslose Installation der Hardware und die Konfiguration der Software,

auch umfassende Tests durch, um die Funktionalität und Integration in Ihre bestehende Infrastruktur
sicherzustellen.
**Service:** Nach der erfolgreichen Integration bieten wir fortlaufenden Support und Wartung an.
Dies umfasst regelmäßige Überprüfungen, Updates und schnelle Reaktionen auf eventuelle Probleme, um
die langfristige Leistungsfähigkeit und Sicherheit des Systems zu gewährleisten.

Technologien zu schulen, um höchste Sicherheit und Effizienz zu gewährleisten. Unsere
Trainingsprogramme werden individuell auf die Bedürfnisse Ihres Unternehmens abgestimmt und können
sowohl vor Ort als auch online durchgeführt werden.

Unser Unternehmen unterstützt Sie bei der Einhaltung der neuesten Sicherheitsstandards durch

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and
measurable operational value.

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

[READ THE REPORT][167]

## security services, Securonix adapts to your operating model.

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

# Migrate to mobile access credentials without new readers

Enroll users at scale with NFC mobile access credentials that work across multiple physical access
control systems, don’t rely on reader hardware, and work alongside existing physical access
credentials.

[ get in touch ][178]
[ Watch video ][179]

## Work with the systems you already have

Readerless mobile access credentials work across major physical access control brands including
[Paxton][180], [Brivo][181], [Lenel][182], [ZKTeco][183], [Genetec][184], and [C•CURE][185], without
new reader hardware having to be installed.

[Gallagher access control integration]
[Brivo access control integration]
[Paxton access control integration]
[SystemHouse Solutions access control integration]
[ZKTeco access control integration]
[Axis Communications access control integration]
[Securitas Technology access control integration]
[Imron access control integration]
[Tedee smart lock integration]
[sofia part of iseo access control integration]
[SkyCommand access control integration]
[mitrefinch access control integration]
[ACT access control integration]
[Avigilon access control integration]
[TDSi access control integration]
[AMAG Technology access control integration]
[Genetec access control integration]
[LenelS2 access control integration]
[ access control system Integrations ][186]

## Transition in days, not months.

With a single integration with your current access control system, users can be enrolled with NFC
mobile credentials that work using our powerless Sentry [Smart Access Tiles][187] to unlock doors.
By using the smartphone as the access credential and reader, organizations can enhance security
through software updates alone, without replacing or installing new door access readers.

[ readerless mobile access credentials ][188]

## No rip and replace. No downtime.

Our open standard mobile credentials compliment your legacy proximity card reader system. No access
control readers are required to be replaced, our software simply adds the option of NFC mobile
access, alongside keycard access.   

[ How It Works ][189]
[commercial real estate mobile access upgrade]

## Keep your existing readers. Add mobile access credentials.

Enjoy a cost-effective software based transition to advanced readerless NFC mobile access, without
any disruption to your legacy access control system.

#### Readerless

Mobile credentials don’t require reader hardware to operate, therefore no reader hardware upgrades
or rip and replace is  necessary to integrate with your legacy access control system.

#### Interoperable

Our open SDK is designed to integrate with multiple major access control systems in addition to a
portfolio of third-party space management and tenant experience applications.

#### Scalable

Mobile credentials can be setup and rolled out remotely in minutes and not days, with no disruption
to existing access control system infrastructure.

#### Secure

The only NIST compliant NFC mobile access credential SDK that delivers the highest banking level
encryption. Time, geofence and IP restrictions available.

[ why choose readerless ][190]

## Got a an existing app? Store mobile access credentials in it.

Our Sentry Mobile Access SDK integrates with third party applications to manage all buildings
effortlessly. No matter the size or sector; from building and facilities management apps, to club,
hospitality, and coworking and visitor management apps, our SDK increase its capabilities to mobile
access credentials.

[ mobile app Integrations ][191]

## Reverse-engineered mobile access

Sentry [Smart Access Tiles][192] require no batteries or power are simply applied next to doors and
linked with the cloud via the QR code. Setup is remote to enable, fast, reliable, and secure
smartphone NFC door entry in no time, without compromising security.

[ Sentry smart access tiles ][193]
[Exploded view of the Sentry NFC tile used for NFC mobile access.]

## Automate visitor access operations

End-users have the ability to manage readerless mobile access credentials for tenants, employees and
visitors from anywhere, at any time, via a desktop, tablet or smartphone. 

[ Digital Key Sharing ][194]

## Built on the highest security standards

Sentry Interactive’s NFC mobile access credentials are engineered for comprehensive security. We are
the only mobile credential SDK provider to follow NIST compliant standards by using the smartphone
as the reader. Military-grade encryption protects user access data in the cloud, while audit logging
and privacy regulation compliance further secure the data.

[logo-pci-dss-compliant]
[logo-cyber-essentials]
[NIST]
[logo-iasme]
[ Our Security ][195]

## Embrace the fastest route to flexible mobile credentials

Extend the life of your access control systems and provide the choice of secure NFC mobile
credentials to automate operations and optimize user experience.

[ Book a demo ][196]

Connect with a member of our team within 24 hours.

Get a system audit for integration.

Deploy and activate mobile credentials within days.

# Migrate to mobile access credentials without new readers

Enroll users at scale with NFC mobile access credentials that work across multiple physical access
control systems, don’t rely on reader hardware, and work alongside existing physical access
credentials.

[ get in touch ][178]
[ Watch video ][179]

## Work with the systems you already have

Readerless mobile access credentials work across major physical access control brands including
[Paxton][180], [Brivo][181], [Lenel][182], [ZKTeco][183], [Genetec][184], and [C•CURE][185], without
new reader hardware having to be installed.

[Gallagher access control integration]
[Brivo access control integration]
[Paxton access control integration]
[SystemHouse Solutions access control integration]
[ZKTeco access control integration]
[Axis Communications access control integration]
[Securitas Technology access control integration]
[Imron access control integration]
[Tedee smart lock integration]
[sofia part of iseo access control integration]
[SkyCommand access control integration]
[mitrefinch access control integration]
[ACT access control integration]
[Avigilon access control integration]
[TDSi access control integration]
[AMAG Technology access control integration]
[Genetec access control integration]
[LenelS2 access control integration]
[ access control system Integrations ][186]

## Transition in days, not months.

With a single integration with your current access control system, users can be enrolled with NFC
mobile credentials that work using our powerless Sentry [Smart Access Tiles][187] to unlock doors.
By using the smartphone as the access credential and reader, organizations can enhance security
through software updates alone, without replacing or installing new door access readers.

[ readerless mobile access credentials ][188]

## No rip and replace. No downtime.

Our open standard mobile credentials compliment your legacy proximity card reader system. No access
control readers are required to be replaced, our software simply adds the option of NFC mobile
access, alongside keycard access.   

[ How It Works ][189]
[commercial real estate mobile access upgrade]

## Keep your existing readers. Add mobile access credentials.

Enjoy a cost-effective software based transition to advanced readerless NFC mobile access, without
any disruption to your legacy access control system.

#### Readerless

Mobile credentials don’t require reader hardware to operate, therefore no reader hardware upgrades
or rip and replace is  necessary to integrate with your legacy access control system.

#### Interoperable

Our open SDK is designed to integrate with multiple major access control systems in addition to a
portfolio of third-party space management and tenant experience applications.

#### Scalable

Mobile credentials can be setup and rolled out remotely in minutes and not days, with no disruption
to existing access control system infrastructure.

#### Secure

The only NIST compliant NFC mobile access credential SDK that delivers the highest banking level
encryption. Time, geofence and IP restrictions available.

[ why choose readerless ][190]

## Got a an existing app? Store mobile access credentials in it.

Our Sentry Mobile Access SDK integrates with third party applications to manage all buildings
effortlessly. No matter the size or sector; from building and facilities management apps, to club,
hospitality, and coworking and visitor management apps, our SDK increase its capabilities to mobile
access credentials.

[ mobile app Integrations ][191]

## Reverse-engineered mobile access

Sentry [Smart Access Tiles][192] require no batteries or power are simply applied next to doors and
linked with the cloud via the QR code. Setup is remote to enable, fast, reliable, and secure
smartphone NFC door entry in no time, without compromising security.

[ Sentry smart access tiles ][193]
[Exploded view of the Sentry NFC tile used for NFC mobile access.]

## Automate visitor access operations

End-users have the ability to manage readerless mobile access credentials for tenants, employees and
visitors from anywhere, at any time, via a desktop, tablet or smartphone. 

[ Digital Key Sharing ][194]

## Built on the highest security standards

Sentry Interactive’s NFC mobile access credentials are engineered for comprehensive security. We are
the only mobile credential SDK provider to follow NIST compliant standards by using the smartphone
as the reader. Military-grade encryption protects user access data in the cloud, while audit logging
and privacy regulation compliance further secure the data.

[logo-pci-dss-compliant]
[logo-cyber-essentials]

[ Our Security ][195]

## Embrace the fastest route to flexible mobile credentials

Extend the life of your access control systems and provide the choice of secure NFC mobile
credentials to automate operations and optimize user experience.

[ Book a demo ][196]

Connect with a member of our team within 24 hours.

Get a system audit for integration.

Deploy and activate mobile credentials within days.

## EXPERT CYBERSECURITY SOLUTIONS PROVIDER FOR GROWING COMPANIES

WE PROTECT GREAT COMPANIES AND THEIR PEOPLE

Your organization is unique. But all too often, cost concerns force mid-market companies to settle
for cookie cutter solutions. Silent Sector provides unbiased vendor and technology-neutral
cybersecurity assessments, guidance, managed cybersecurity services, and program implementation to
keep your company compliant and ahead of the threats. We design solutions for mid-market and
emerging companies in the healthcare, financial services, technology, education, manufacturing, and
defense industries.

[An illustration of virtual data-1]

### Expertise Impact Methodology

Our experts become an extension of your organization

Silent Sector's unique Expertise Impact Model™ streamlines cost and response time by putting you in
direct contact with the experts you need.  Using an asymmetrical warfare approach based on US Army
Special Forces experience, our Expertise Impact Model maximizes capabilities of your internal and
external resources.  This force multiplication methodology also focuses on getting the most value
from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

## Compliance Services

development, vCISO consulting, risk assessments, and penetration testing services to software
companies, healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, defense contractors, educational
institutions, and other organizations requiring resilient and compliant cyber risk management

[Sunlite Systems Pvt Ltd][148], headquartered in Ghaziabad, was founded in 2012 to close a real gap
in the Indian market — businesses needed one dependable source for genuine, warranty-backed IT and
AV equipment instead of juggling a dozen scattered vendors. That single idea has since grown into a
PAN-India supply operation trusted by corporates, institutions and government buyers alike.

Directors Mr. Shainki Bansal (Rohit) and Mr. Jatin Goyal lead a catalogue built around what
businesses actually deploy day to day: [Samsung Interactive Flat Panels][149], [All-in-One
PCs][150], projectors, [ALR projector screens][151], [teleprompters][152], video & audio
conferencing systems, commercial LFD displays, video walls, digital signage, CCTV and 4K PTZ
surveillance cameras, networking gear and enterprise storage — sourced straight from authorized
brand channels, never grey-market.

A 15-strong in-house team, carrying a combined 20+ years in the IT/AV trade, handles everything from
pre-sales consulting to installation — which is why we've become a go-to wholesale and channel
partner for [Samsung Interactive Flat Panels][153], [All-in-One PCs][154], [projector screens][155]
and [teleprompters][156], alongside networking, storage and CCTV surveillance deployments for
offices, schools and public-sector projects nationwide.

in the Indian market — businesses needed one dependable source for genuine, warranty-backed IT and
AV equipment instead of juggling a dozen scattered vendors. That single idea has since grown into a
PAN-India supply operation trusted by corporates, institutions and government buyers alike.

Directors Mr. Shainki Bansal (Rohit) and Mr. Jatin Goyal lead a catalogue built around what
businesses actually deploy day to day: [Samsung Interactive Flat Panels][149], [All-in-One
PCs][150], projectors, [ALR projector screens][151], [teleprompters][152], video & audio
conferencing systems, commercial LFD displays, video walls, digital signage, CCTV and 4K PTZ
surveillance cameras, networking gear and enterprise storage — sourced straight from authorized
brand channels, never grey-market.

A 15-strong in-house team, carrying a combined 20+ years in the IT/AV trade, handles everything from
pre-sales consulting to installation — which is why we've become a go-to wholesale and channel
partner for [Samsung Interactive Flat Panels][153], [All-in-One PCs][154], [projector screens][155]

offices, schools and public-sector projects nationwide.

What is PACS access control?

PACS (Physical Access Control System) is an integrated security solution that electronically manages
and monitors who can enter specific areas of your facility, when they can enter, and tracks all
access activity in real-time

###  

How do mobile credentials work with access control?

Mobile credentials transform your smartphone into a secure digital key, eliminating the need for
physical cards or fobs. This technology uses Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Near Field Communication
(NFC), or QR codes to authenticate users at access control readers.

###  

###  

What Are the Benefits of Cloud-Based Access Control?

# Comprehensive Access Control System Solutions

25 Years of Successful Installations and Service Across North America, Hawaii, and the Caribbean.
Welcome to York Access Control, your turnkey solution for your access control and security needs. We
are authorized dealers, and certified installers for many of the top manufactures, specializing in
**DormaKaba - SALTO - Open Path and Brivo**.

or [Explore Our Services & Products »][10]

### Our Featured Security Solutions:

## [Products & Accessories][11]

York Access Control stocks most common access control products. We also are distributors for
Dormakaba – Salto – Brivo and Open Path. If you need a quote for an access control system, you have
come to the right place. If you just need a few parts, oh hey look you still came to the right
place! Whether big or small, we can supply it all and would love to help.

[Learn More »][12]

## [Access Control Installation][13]

With over 25 years of experience, York Access Control continues to provide high quality
installations for all types of access control systems. Whether it’s an office, warehouse, school, or
hotel. We have a team of well trained technicians ready to complete your project and bring you peace
of mind.

[Learn More »][14]

## [Service Contracts][15]

York Access Control offers customizable service contracts, tailored to your specific property, that
keep your property issue free, and staff well trained. Service contracts have been proven to reduce
downtime, increase revenue, minimize security risks and improve staff/guest experiences.

[Learn More »][16]

## [Emergency Technical Support][17]

Sometimes emergencies happen. Your key system goes down, a guest gets locked out, a staff member
cant enter the building, or parking gate wont open. Whatever it is, a solution is needed
immediately. In order to address this problem, we have two types of emergency support solutions. One
virtual and the other an on-site visit.

[Learn More »][18]

## Who We Serve

York Access Control proudly serves a variety of industries, including:

### Hospitality

Trusted by leading hotel brands like Hilton, Marriott, and IHG. We have the experience to assist
with any Hospitality related project.

### Military

With countless Military bases installed, and even one aircraft carrier we have the experience, and
background, to assist with any Military project.

### Commercial & Retail

Whether its a large distribution center, or a small office, we are able to assist with all your
commercial needs.

#### DEALER & CERTIFIED INSTALLER

## The York Access Control Difference

At York Access Control, you get what you pay for – exceptional service and quality. Founded by
Christopher York, our second-generation family business is built on precision, integrity, and fair
pricing.

**Why choose York Access Control?**
* **On-Time Installations:** We stick to scheduled dates.
* **Clear Communication:** Delays or issues are shared promptly.
* **Fair Pricing:** Relationships matter more than profits.
* **Expert Guidance:** Decades of experience means tailored solutions.

attack surfaces, validating stolen credentials, and executing account takeover inside encrypted
traffic.
